items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: That was David Jones' band. ... Dutto Poynall playing alto saxophone. ... That's right, yeah, that's right. He was gonna play drums and like that.

ctx.x: I think of alto with him. He was playing alto, right? Teo was playing tenor and alto. Tenor and alto, yeah. Mostly tenor. Mostly tenor. Yeah. Well, he was in St. Louis long after I got to… You know, taking notes with him. Did you ever play clarinet? No, I didn't. Just the alto set. Just the alto. And I take him from David Jones. David Jones. But he went to Texas. And well, that's when Buddy changed me over. He came. I was in the right neighborhood right around the corner. He came one day and I was rehearsing at…
He took on Abbie Foster. Chinese.
